capabilities.name: Search intelligence evidence
capabilities.description: Search the authorised Pulse evidence corpus using provider-neutral semantic retrieval and return canonical evidence identities plus retrieval freshness. Tenant scope comes from caller-bound Control Plane context; operation authority and classification clearance come from the authenticated Pulse resource-server token. The capability does not expose vector-store identities, embeddings or provider-specific retrieval structures.

capabilities.name: Manage intelligence research mission
capabilities.description: Create or retrieve a governed research mission that frames an intelligence question, evidence expectations, scope, classification and confidence requirement without exposing Haystack, model-provider or pipeline internals. Tenant scope comes from caller-bound Control Plane context; operation and classification authority come from the authenticated Pulse resource-server token. This capability owns the Pulse research workflow only; it does not confer authority over operational engines or regulatory decisions.
